summary: Customer produces an opaque, concentrated milk product flowing through a processing line, currently samples it for fat and protein, and wants an initial spectroscopy concept plus a practical comparison experiment to obtain earlier information about composition changes, while keeping laboratory checks. Temperature and texture vary during production.
